paragraphs: Google was founded in September 1998 by Larry Page and Sergey Brin while they were Ph.D. students at Stanford University in California.
Android is a mobile operating system based on a modified version of the Linux kernel, developed by Google for smartphones and tablets.
Vite is a modern frontend build tool that is extremely fast, leveraging native ES modules and Rollup for optimized production builds.
Google Chrome is a cross-platform web browser released in 2008, built with free software components from Apple WebKit and Mozilla.
